payload.title: Add tasks fleet close-orphans with a lossless check
payload.body:
Add a fleet command that closes PRs whose task is gone, only after a lossless check proves every commit is already on the base branch or the work is captured elsewhere. Dry run by default; --yes to close. Sources: https://github.com/fyodoriv/minsky/blob/main/scripts/auto-close-orphan-prs.mjs and https://github.com/fyodoriv/minsky/blob/main/scripts/verify-pr-closure-is-lossless.mjs (credit only).
- **Hypothesis**: a lossless check before closing cuts wrongly closed PRs (work lost) from unknown to 0 while clearing orphan PRs automatically.
- **Measurement**: npm test -w packages/cli -- fleet-close-orphans (fixtures: merged-equivalent, unique-commits)
- **Success**: 0 PRs with unique commits are closed in the fixture run; every merged-equivalent PR is closed.
- **Pivot**: if one real lossy close occurs, remove --yes and keep report-only output.
- **Anchor**: Kitchenham, Dybå, Jørgensen 2004 (evidence before action).
